people.role: Lantern keeper of the Trà Viên crossroads
people.backstory: Phù Kiều-born like the founder, he lights the Trà Viên crossroads lanterns for Hàm Thanh Đăng (ham_thanh_dang) and brings Bàng Yên Tỏa (bang_yen_toa) the crossroads' fees each season, with a line for each on what it paid for. He saw the founder's lantern burning on the Đồng Sơn road in 1146, and has not been forgiven for keeping quiet until 1198.

ties.note: the head, who asks him what each fee paid for

people.role: Carter captain of the Yên Ba salt-fish carts; outer for life
people.backstory: He drove Diêm Hải Tảo's (diem_hai_tao) salt-fish carts before he joined and still leads them on the mist road under Thai Vãn Xa (thai_van_xa). He counts every cart in at Yên Ba for the fee, and his count is longer than Thai's. He pays the road fee from his own wage for any child he finds walking.

tree.intent: Water, the damp that holds mist down.

people.role: Stonecutter's son who holds the chisel for the milestones
people.backstory: A stonecutter's son of Thạch Công Thôn, he holds the chisel for Mao Đạo Bi (mao_dao_bi) when a mist seal goes into a dead guard's milestone. Every spring he recuts the seal on the milestone by Đồng Sơn Trấn, because the cap stone keeps being lifted.

people.role: Survivor of the 1190 caravan; lantern girl of the Phù Kiều road
people.backstory: She was in Ký Thất Lộ's (ky_that_lo) caravan in 1190 and was carried out by Bối Trường Đình (boi_truong_dinh), who died holding the mist. She does not want revenge, and Ký cannot forgive her for it.

people.role: Mist-layer who trains against Khuyết Lạc Vụ in Mê Vụ Lâm
people.backstory: Thằng Tác-born like Khuyết Lạc Vụ (khuyet_lac_vu), he trains beside her in Mê Vụ Lâm and has never once found her in her mist. The head calls him the second-best mist-layer on the cape, and he has heard.

people.role: A robber's son from the Bobtail ridge, hidden by the road captain
people.backstory: Triều Ngũ Lang (trieu_ngu_lang) brought him down from the Bobtail ridge in 1192 after his father's band turned on itself. The sect asked him nothing. This year he is posted on the Đồng Sơn road with Ký Thất Lộ (ky_that_lo) and talks to him about the ridge's paths; Ký has not learned whose son he is.

ties.note: brought him down from the ridge
Ký does not know whose son he is

people.role: Tập Xuân Trà's cousin; brews the road tea
people.backstory: Tập Xuân Trà's (tap_xuan_tra) cousin from the tea terraces brews the guards' gourd tea and serves it at the spring dinner. She is saving her wage to buy back her family's terrace from a Yên Ba tea broker, and is two seasons short.
